androidCallPermissionError: Call settings could not be opened. You can retry in Profile → Check-in call center.
enableNotificationsFirstDesc: You can enable notifications when you want reminders. Core features remain available without them.
logoutConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to log out of your account?
deleteAccountWarning: This deletes your account and its associated data in Asinu.
deleteWarning1: You will be signed out after your account has been successfully deleted.
deleteWarning2: Your profile, health history and family connections will be deleted.
deleteWarning3: Deleted data cannot be restored. Consider carefully before confirming.
deleteWarning4: Manage previously shared data in “Consultation data” before deleting your account.

privacyCenterDescription: Choose how you share and manage your consultation data.
privacyDescription_export: Get a copy of your records and conversations to save or share.
privacyDescription_anonymize: Remove identifying details from previous consultation data. This cannot be undone.
privacyAnonymizedDescription: Previous consultation data has been anonymized and cannot be restored. You can still allow sharing for a new consultation.
privacyDescription_delete: Delete consultation data stored in Asinu.
privacyRequestSuccess: Your data rights request is complete.
privacyRequestError: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
privacyHistoryEmpty: Your data actions will be recorded here.
privacySharingDescription: Allow necessary data to be used when you request a consultation.
privacySettingsError: Privacy settings could not be loaded. Please try again.
privacyConfirmBody_grant_consent: Necessary health data can be shared when you submit a new consultation request. Cancelled consultations and deleted data will not be restored.
privacyConfirmBody_withdraw_consent: You will stop providing data to specialists. Previously shared data will remain stored. To consult again, allow sharing and submit a new request.
privacyConfirmBody_anonymize: Identifying information will be removed and copies of consultation data in Asinu will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
privacyConfirmBody_delete: Consultation data in Asinu will be deleted. The specialist system keeps anonymized records and an activity trail. This cannot be undone.
privacySuccess_anonymize: Personal details have been removed from consultation data.
privacySuccess_delete: Consultation data in Asinu has been deleted.
privacyHistoryError: Activity history could not be loaded. Please try again.
privacyCancellationWarningTitle: Ongoing and waiting consultations will be cancelled
privacyCancellationWarningBody: You will no longer be able to continue these conversations. Allowing sharing again will not reopen cancelled consultations.
